# Metropolis Japan

> > Tokyo's premier English-language magazine covering Japanese culture, dining, travel, and urban life.

Metropolis Japan is an established lifestyle and culture publication serving the international community in Japan. It features restaurant reviews, travel guides to destinations like Fukuoka and Kyoto, urban development stories from neighborhoods like Roppongi and Shibuya, and cultural commentary on contemporary Japanese society.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo dining and restaurants
- Roppongi nightlife and development
- Fukuoka travel
- Kyoto culture and art
- Japanese urban planning and architecture
- Roppongi Hills
- Shibuya district
- Hakata and Tenjin districts
- Fine dining reviews
- Japanese cities travel guides
- Urban rebranding projects
- Kansai region
- Modern Japanese architecture
- Tokyo nightlife
- Japanese lifestyle trends

## Travel Guides

- [Fukuoka | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/fukuoka): Travel guide to Fukuoka: architecture, Hakata district & Momochi area
- [Katsuura | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/katsuura): Katsuura travel guide: Chiba fishing town, Hebara Beach & Boso peninsula
- [Snowy Japan | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/snowy-japan): Ski resort guide: Shiga Kogen & Nagano winter sports destinations

## Urban Development & Architecture

- [The View From the Hills | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/the-view-from-the-hills): Minoru Mori's Omotesando Hills development & Tokyo urban planning
- [Sign of the Times | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/sign-of-the-times): Roppongi urban rebranding: High Touch Town logo & district revitalization

## Restaurant Reviews

- [Shun | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/shun): Restaurant review: Shun fusion dining at Izumi Garden, Roppongi
- [Tsuge | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/tsuge): Yakitori restaurant review: Tsuge izakaya in Otemachi, Tokyo
- [Hanabusa | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/hanabusa): Traditional kaiseki dining review: Hanabusa in Soto-Kanda, Tokyo
- [Cosari | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/cosari): Korean organic restaurant review: Cosari in Gaienmae, Aoyama
- [Gindaco | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/gindaco): Takoyaki restaurant review: Gindaco Osaka-style fast food in Ginza
- [10 Zen | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/10-zen-2): Vegetarian yakuzen cuisine review: 10 Zen in Shinagawa, Tokyo

## Culture & Society

- [Marijuana Underground | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/marijuana-underground): Japan cannabis culture: 420 Japan, drug policy & marijuana arrests
- [Here Be Monsters | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/here-be-monsters): Japanese paranormal phenomena: ESP research, death cults & mysteries
- [Carrie Nation | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/carrie-nation): Sex and the City influence on Tokyo fashion & lifestyle trends
- [Scene Around Kyoto | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/scene-around-kyoto): Kyoto art: Yokai manga exhibition at International Manga Museum
- [Kaori Manabe | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/kaori-manabe): Fuji TV announcer Kaori Manabe in political controversy over likeness use

## Features & Interviews

- [Jason Kelly | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/jason-kelly): Author interview: Jason Kelly on investment advice & expat life in Tochigi
- [Rock Of Ages | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/rock-of-ages-2): Musician profile: Jimmy Angel's rockabilly & Elvis connection in Tokyo
- [The Miele Guide Restaurant Month | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/the-miele-guide-restaurant-month): Charity dining event: Miele Guide Restaurant Month for UN World Food

## Optional

- [Sep 4, 2009 | Metropolis Japan](https://metropolisjapan.com/sep-4-2009): News satire: H1N1 swine flu, fashion & election coverage humor
